components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.45rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--brand, #B84408); background: var(--brand, #B84408); color: #FFFFFF; font: 650 0.9375rem/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, #963605); border-color: var(--brand-hover, #963605); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #B84408); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Room Switcher Tab
components.description: Persistent left-rail laboratory selector showing space icon, live free-slot badge, metadata, and compact 10-seat meter.
components.css: .ds-room-tab { width: 100%; max-width: 18rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.95rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #D4D8E0); background: var(--surface-tint, #F9FAFB); color: var(--ink, #171B20); text-align: left; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-room-tab:hover { background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--brand, #B84408); } .ds-room-tab[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--brand, #B84408); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--brand, #B84408); } .ds-room-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #B84408); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-room-tab-head { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-room-tab-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-room-tab-title svg { color: var(--brand-ink, #A63C06); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-room-tab-count { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--brand, #B84408); color: #FFFFFF; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-room-tab-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #4C525C); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-meter-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.65rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seat-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-seat-meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; width: 12rem; } .ds-seat-cell { display: block; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ok, #0E6A52); } .ds-seat-cell.is-low { background: var(--brand, #B84408); } .ds-seat-cell.is-used { background: #D8DCE4; } .ds-seat-cap { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ok-ink, #0B5542); } .ds-seat-cap.is-low { color: var(--warn-ink, #7A4106); }

components.css: .ds-week-sample { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-day-btn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.15rem; min-width: 3.25rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #D4D8E0); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #171B20); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-day-btn small { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #4C525C); } .ds-day-btn strong { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 750; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-day-btn[aria-current="date"] { background: var(--ink, #171B20); border-color: var(--ink, #171B20); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-day-btn[aria-current="date"] small { color: #E0E4EC; } .ds-day-btn[aria-current="date"]:hover { background: #252B33; border-color: #252B33; } .ds-day-btn.is-weekend { background: var(--rail, #EAECEF); border-style: dashed; border-color: #BFC5D0; color: var(--muted, #4C525C); opacity: 0.72; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-day-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand, #B84408); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-tag-group { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; background: var(--ok-bg, #E7F4EF); color: var(--ok-ink, #0B5542); border: 1px solid var(--ok-line, #9FD4C3); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-tag[data-state="PENDIENTE"] { background: var(--warn-bg, #FEF4E2); color: var(--warn-ink, #7A4106); border-color: var(--warn-line, #E7C58B); } .ds-status-tag[data-state="COMPLETO"] { background: var(--rail, #EAECEF); color: var(--muted, #4C525C); border-color: var(--line, #D4D8E0); }

narrative.overview:
Plano de Aulario treats laboratory booking as a European university architectural schedule rather than a multi-step SaaS dashboard. The institutional burnt-orange header of the Facultad de Ciencias Políticas y Sociología (UGR) anchors every screen, holding the official Faculty emblem inside a crisp white plaque while keeping the operational surface calm, legible, and fast under campus daylight and mobile thumbs.

Beneath the header, a flush left mineral rail holds the three laboratories (Laboratorio de radio, Laboratorio cualitativo 1, and Laboratorio cualitativo 2) together with live availability counts and schematic floorplans, while the right-hand daylight canvas displays a 7-day week bar and a 1px-ruled hourly timetable from 08:00 to 21:00. Instead of generic floating cards, shadows, or decorative marketing copy, clarity comes from crisp hairline borders, tabular numerals, and a signature 10-segment occupancy meter that lets students and staff read room capacity in a single glance.

The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS chrome: no warm-beige AI backdrops, no nested cards inside cards, no colored left-accent stripes on rounded containers, and no drop shadows on resting surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional burnt-orange sticky header anchoring the Faculty emblem and active `@go.ugr.es` session across all surfaces.
Full-bleed two-column workspace on desktop (flush 320px mineral rail plus ruled white schedule sheet) collapsing to a 3-tab top switcher and touch-ready week strip on mobile.
Zero resting shadows: hierarchy relies on cool mineral daylight layering (`#EAECEF` rail, `#F4F5F7` ground, `#FFFFFF` sheet) and crisp `1px` rules.
Tabular-numeral timetable rows with a 10-segment architectural seat meter for Cualitativo 2 (`10` concurrent workstations) and a single-bar status track for full-room bookings.
Native browser accessibility primitives throughout: `<dialog closedby="any">` modals, ARIA `tablist` keyboard navigation, `≥44px`/`48px` touch targets, and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (`≥4.5:1`).

rules.name: The Faculty Header Rule
rules.body: Faculty Orange anchors the sticky top bar and primary actions, never sprawling across body backgrounds or competing with availability green.

rules.name: The Single-Meaning Teal Rule
rules.body: Capacity Teal appears exclusively for available room/seat capacity and confirmed valid/approved states—never as a decorative icon or secondary button fill.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every hour range (`08:00 – 09:00`), date numeral, seat fraction (`6/10 libres`), KPI counter, and character counter sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns never jitter on state updates.

rules.name: The Fixed Step Rule
rules.body: Heading sizes use fixed `rem` steps (`32px / 24px / 18px / 16px`, ≥1.25× jump per level) with `text-wrap: balance` on headings and `text-wrap: pretty` on paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every resting surface on the canvas is strictly shadow-free. Only top-layer modals cast an exterior shadow.

dos: Do keep the sticky Faculty Orange header (`#B84408`) with the white-framed official Faculty emblem (`logo-facultad.jpg`) as the institutional anchor across all pages.
Do use tabular numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) on every time slot, date tile, seat ratio, KPI card, and character counter.
Do separate surfaces through tonal mineral steps (`#EAECEF` rail, `#F4F5F7` ground, `#FFFFFF` sheets) and `1px` hairlines (`#D4D8E0`) instead of shadows.

Do enforce native `<dialog closedby="any">` modals with `autofocus` on the safe keep action for destructive actions (`#cancelDialog`, `#deleteBlockDialog`) and reset `dialog.returnValue = ''` on close.
Do preserve `≥44px` interactive tap targets (`≥48px` on `@media (pointer: coarse)`) and `≥4.5:1` WCAG AA contrast on every text/control state.

Do respect strict static CSP (`script-src 'self'`, `style-src 'self'`, `font-src 'self'`, `require-trusted-types-for 'script'`) using self-hosted `Schibsted Grotesk` WOFF2 fonts and zero inline styles or `innerHTML`.
donts: Don't introduce warm cream/beige backgrounds, floating marketing hero banners, or drop shadows on resting containers.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards or attach decorative colored left-border accent bars to rounded elements.
Don't use Capacity Teal (`#0E6A52`) for decorative accents or non-capacity buttons; reserve it strictly for open availability and verified valid/approved states.
Don't load external font CDNs, third-party JS CDNs, or raw `:invalid` error styling that flags untouched form inputs before user interaction.
Don't trigger destructive deletions or cancellations immediately on click or via browser `window.prompt`/`window.confirm` popups.
